claims: ## Anchor R&D Surface v12 â€” "Efforts" Â· Planning Trio Summary
**Objective / North Star (LOCKED 2026-06-21)**

v12 makes a project's trio work **continuity-first**: an "effort" is ONE session by default that flows Research â†’ Plan â†’ Build in the same conversation, where the stage transition is a **lightweight relabel, not a managed handoff** â€” with a fresh-session handoff reserved only as a context-relief valve, and every effort's docs/deliverable/summary durably saved and reopenable on a Layout-D dashboard.

It is framed as a **correctness + UX fix** to the v6â€“v11.1 model, which ran the trio as separate sessions linked by a chain with a managed handoff at every boundary â€” six versions of the most bug-prone, awkward seam. The fix is "stop *managing a handoff* at every boundary," not delete the session boundary.
**Key decisions (8 success criteria)**

**SC1 â€” In-session stages:** "Advance" = relabel + persist + summarize the completed stage; spawns **no new session** and injects **nothing** into the PTY. Auto-detected on a high-precision on-disk signal, with a manual **Advance â†’** override; tile migrates Research zone â†’ Plan/Build zone.

**SC2 â€” Context-relief handoff:** when context fills (or by choice), Anchor warns + offers a one-click handoff to a fresh session that JOINS the same effort, carrying docs+summary via the proven v11.1 machinery; nothing auto-submitted.

**SC3 â€” Layout D dashboard:** latest-research headline + collapsible shelf; latest-plan/build headline + shelf; persistent right column (Grass + Deliverables); a single bottom docked window with summary-on-top + a height-resizable terminal.
**SC4 â€” Always durable, no Save button:** per-stage docs + per-stage summary (written before close) + auto-resolved/pinned build deliverable; efforts reopenable and can seed new efforts.
**SC5 â€” Grass workbench:** two-pane, ONE session per idea (no Research/Plan split), Migrate-to-project â†‘, âœ•â†’Boneyard.

**SC6/SC7/SC8 â€”** General + Boneyard retained; **legacy chains grouped, not rewritten** (a non-destructive view layer that self-heals from the registry, rollback = ignore the view); stdlib-only / hermetic-test / Playwright-dev-only invariants preserved.
**The critical discriminator: `effort_managed`**

A v12 effort carries `effort_managed=True`, set ONLY by v12 entrypoints (+ New effort, `handoff_to_fresh`, `advance_stage`/`finish_stage`). Legacy records (incl. v6/v8/v10/v11 healthcheck synthetics) normalize to `False`.

**Every retirement gate keys on `effort_managed`, never on `kind`/`current_stage`** (which legacy records also carry) â€” so all legacy walks keep passing unchanged while no effort can mint a second session through a legacy path (Shark C3).

**Effort record (extends `session_registry`):** adds `kind`, `current_stage`, append-only `stage_history` (with per-stage `store_lane`, `baseline_ref`, `state âˆˆ {active,done,interrupted}`), `seeded_stages`, `effort_id` (stable = root session_id), `effort_managed`. All back-compat; `lane` becomes the mutable current store-lane, board routes by `current_stage`/`kind`.

**Keystone A â€” per-stage baseline commit + stage-scoped persist (the doc-attribution fix):** at each stage start, record a baseline commit; the stage's produced-doc set = exact git `diff <baseline>..HEAD` âˆª `diff <baseline> --` âˆª `status --porcelain -uall` additions, **minus** prior closed-stage paths. Fixes the BLOCKER that a shared worktree's whole-tree diff would mis-attribute docs across stages.

**Keystone B â€” stage-keyed summaries:** thread `stage` through the summarizer; cache under `<store_lane>/summaries/<sid>/<stage>/`; bump `SUMMARY_SCHEMA_VERSION` 2â†’3 (stale = MISS â†’ heal); closed stages read via recorded `store_lane` (survives a lane flip).

**`finish_stage` non-reaping durability:** factor persist+summarize out of `kill` so a stage boundary never tears down the shared worktree; `kill` keeps calling it then reaps (behavior byte-identical).

**`advance_stage` (relabel+save):** under WRITE_LOCK, idempotent (no-op if already advanced â€” handles manual+auto race), ZERO PTY bytes by default; conversation-only capture via the v11.1 transcript-snapshot path.
**`detect_stage_progress`:** on-disk high-precision signal only (committed MASTER+IMPL pair / EXECUTION-LOG newer than stage start); reads ZERO PTY bytes; conversation-only stages don't auto-advance.

**Complete retirement map:** all SIX legacy session-minting paths (`auto_advance_planning_to_build` + its term_kill/finish_to_build/reconcile call sites, both advance endpoints, both `_PROJECT_WINDOW_JS` advance bars) plus the grass second-advance early-return for `effort_managed` efforts.

**NEW `effort_view.py`:** `build_effort_view` groups registry records by `chain_id` â†’ ONE effort per chain, rebuilt from the registry each call (derived cache, not a source), deduped (live wins), drift-safe (deleted member drops, no ghost), SAFE projections. The only new module â€” stdlib-only, in `dist_manifest.txt`.

W1 record fields/back-compat â†’ W2 **Layout-D static skeleton (UI-gated, ship the look early)** â†’ W3 Keystone A â†’ W4 Keystone B â†’ W5 `finish_stage` refactor â†’ W6 `advance_stage` â†’ W7 `detect_stage_progress` + complete retirement map â†’ W8 context-relief handoff + restart recovery â†’ W9 effort view-layer â†’ W10 **wire Layout-D live (UI-gated)** â†’ W11 **grass workbench + General + Boneyard (UI-gated)** â†’ W12 CLI mirror + `check_rnd_v12_surface` + distro + docs.
UI ships **early as a static skeleton (W2)** then wired live (W10), resolving the "ship UI early" sequencing without forward-referencing the backbone.

Every advance/handoff/stage test is **worktree-only** (write docs into the worktree, never `record_effort` pre-persist); conversation-only stages **seed the stub PTY read buffer** (no file); each advance asserts session-id **SET equality** (not `len`) to survive reconcile churn.
W3's falsification is mandatory: in the same state, the legacy whole-tree diff must be asserted a **superset**, proving the stage-scoped result is a strict subset.

UI waves (2, 10, 11) require rendered-DOM (pos+neg) + a real Playwright/Chromium test with **machine-checkable** pass conditions + a screenshot vs the named mockup (+ named deltas) + John's sign-off; a string-grep-only gate is an automatic HALT.

**Round 1 (Master Plan):** all 3 Sharks BLOCKed the first "literally one shared session/worktree/context" draft. John's lived-workflow evidence reframed it to continuity-first + context-relief handoff, converting the â‰¥2-agree BLOCKERs (doc-attribution, summary cache key, legacy auto-advance spawning) into named engineering items.

**Round 2 (Implementation Plan):** Sequencing=BLOCK, Testability=BLOCK, Completeness=SHIP-WITH-FIXES â€” folded in the complete `effort_managed`-gated retirement map, exact git mechanics + superset falsification, conversation-only GWTs + set-equality, schema bump to 3, restart `interrupted` literal, Playwright machine-checkable conditions, and split over-bundled waves.
Convergence authority: **John** (locked the revised model + sequencing 2026-06-21).
**Explicit non-goals**

No calendar / Anchor-as-app work; no changes to the trio skills (researchPrime/Crucible/Foreman); no git/gh seam changes; no multi-user/cloud/auth change; no literal forced single Claude context across skills; no destructive rewrite of existing session/chain records.

Note: per the git status, v12 is BUILT (12 waves GREEN) on branch `foreman/rnd-surface-v12` but **not yet merged/deployed** â€” awaiting John's whole-branch sign-off â†’ merge + `nssm restart anchor` + rescan.
**North Star (LOCKED 2026-06-21)**
The objective is that John can run a unit of work as a single continuous **"effort"** that flows Research â†’ Plan â†’ Build in **ONE session by default**.
The stage transition is a **lightweight relabel, not a managed handoff**.
A **fresh-session handoff exists only as a context-relief valve** â€” used when context fills, not as the normal path.
Every effort's **docs, deliverable, and summary are durably saved and reopenable**.
The effort is **surfaced on the simple Layout-D dashboard**.
**Continuity-first model**
Continuity is the default, but a context-relief handoff exists **precisely so context never has to be force-shared** across stages.
The design explicitly rejects a literal "one Claude context forced through all three skills" â€” the relief valve is what avoids forcing that.
**Non-goals (explicitly OUT of scope â€” "Grasscatch")**
**No** calendar / "Anchor-as-app" work â€” those are separate efforts.
**No** changes to the trio **skills** themselves (researchPrime / Crucible / Foreman).
**No** change to the git/gh seams (`worktrees._git` / `ANCHOR_GH_CMD`).
**No** multi-user / cloud / auth-model change.
**No** destructive rewrite of existing session/chain records (continuity is achieved non-destructively).
Member docs are the v12 **Master Plan** and the Foreman-ready **Implementation Plan**, both titled "Efforts (continuity-first single-session trio)".
